text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"So much fun~!!
Encore!!"

text_block_list.name: Helios's Friends
text_block_list.text:
Gyahaha!
Way to go, Helios!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ohh!!
You guys came too!?

text_block_list.name: Helios's Friends
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
How could I not watch the Smash Captain smash it up?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Heeh~?
So, how was I!?"

text_block_list.name: Helios's Friends
text_block_list.text: THE BEST!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahahahaha♪
Totally☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
Helios really looks like she's having a blast...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I wish I could smile like that too...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That was seriously so much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yay, good job out there!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Peace☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It ended so fast though, big sad!
When's the next race?!
choice_data_list: What kind of race would you like?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh!
That totally hypes me up!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "We'll draw an even bigger crowd than today, it'll basically be a festival, and everyone's gonna be super hyped—it'll be totally lit!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In short, it's a high-profile race with a strong lineup of competitors.
Which means, a Junior-class GⅠ...
choice_data_list: Between Hanshin and Nakayama, which do you prefer?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hanshin!
I just love the Kansai vibe!
choice_data_list: What about the Juvenile and the Futurity?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Fuchsia... That's so hard to say!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Juvenile!!
Juveniling! Yeah, that rolls off the tongue nicely!
choice_data_list: Then maybe the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Hopeful Stakes" is another option, but judging
from the atmosphere today, starting with a mile distance
would be best.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: K!
choice_data_list: You sure make quick decisions, as always!
You sure make quick decisions, as always!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... The Hanshin JF is a GⅠ!
The competition's gonna be insane, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aren't the other girls entering super strong?
Are you gonna be okay right off the bat?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: The sketchier it is, the more hype it gets, right?
choice_data_list: Besides, with Helios's ability, she'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her run today confirmed it.
She truly is an Umamusume with the capability
to shine in top-tier races. There's no doubt about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, good point!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios, you were amazing!
It really gave me so much energy, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go cheer for you at the Hanshin JF too!
Go have yourself a great time!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Thx~☆
Let's go eat some Insta-worthy food together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the next target race was decided: the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies!
